summary: Flathead NF cabin near Seeley Lake, Powell County, MT; 1930s L-4 cab, abandoned 1956, burned 1959 per one listing; listed as gone.

facts.status_note: Burned 1959 per firelookout.com; Forest Fire Lookout Association lists it as gone

events.note: Source gives only the 1930s; 1930 stands in for the decade and is not a date from the source
Burned 1959 per firelookout.com; only listing found for this date

evidence.supports: about 11 miles northeast of Seeley Lake
USGS name entry lists the Lolo National Forest as a related term
USGS name entry lists the Flathead National Forest as a related term
Forest Fire Lookout Association lists the site as gone

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Both lookout listings put the cabin on the Flathead National Forest. The USGS name entry lists the Flathead and Lolo national forests as related terms without saying which holds the peak. The story follows the lookout listings.

notes_for_editor: Only two lookout listings and a USGS name entry. The build decade, the 1956 abandonment and the 1959 burn rest on the firelookout.com listing alone. A search summary gave a 1938 build year that no page we read supports, so it is not used. Brief's status 'gone' matches the Forest Fire Lookout Association list. No corrections proposed. Nothing found on staffing, on what remains at the site, or on public access; the access field is left out.
